memberdef.name: findSurvivorBackwards

briefdescription.para: Given the bitvector Available of free register units at position From.

detaileddescription.para: Search backwards to find a register that is part of Candidates and not used/clobbered until the point To. If there is multiple candidates continue searching and pick the one that is not used/ clobbered for the longest time. Returns the register and the earliest position we know it to be free or the position MBB.end() if no register is available.

briefdescription.para: Allocate a register for the virtual register VReg.

detaileddescription.para: The last use of VReg is around the current position of the register scavenger RS. ReserveAfter controls whether the scavenged register needs to be reserved after the current instruction, otherwise it will only be reserved before the current instruction.

briefdescription.para: Allocate (scavenge) vregs inside a single basic block.

detaileddescription.para: Returns true if the target spill callback created new vregs and a 2nd pass is necessary.

briefdescription.para: This file implements the machine register scavenger.

detaileddescription.para: It can provide information, such as unused registers, at any point in a machine basic block. It also provides a mechanism to make registers available by evicting them to spill slots.
